newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine president supports central bank chief.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine president supports central bank chief.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma has said he will recommend to parliament that Viktor Yushchenko remain in the position of central bank chairman.
"I do not see an alternative to Yushchenko and intend to support his candidacy again, for parliament's approval," Kuchma told reporters in the port city of Mykolayiv late on Thursday.
Kuchma complimented Yushchenko on Ukraine's currency reform programme. The hryvnia replaced the interim karbovanets currency with few problems during a two-week period earlier this month.

Ukraine's new constitution, passed in late June, states that parliament must formally support the central bank chairman. Yushchenko was appointed to his post in 1993. --Yuri Kulikov, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
